subject: Future Tech
title: Tesla's Vision-Only Bet
description: A micro-lesson that makes Tesla's Vision-Only Bet usable.

hook.text: Elon Musk removed lidar, radar, and ultrasonics from Tesla. Eight cameras and AI are all you need, he says.

buildup.text: Tesla's FSD uses vision-only AI trained on billions of miles of video from its fleet of millions of cars.

twist.text: Despite the name, FSD is Level 2. The driver must supervise at all times.

climax.text: Tesla plans a robotaxi called Cybercab for 2026.

punchline.text: Millions of cars, billions of miles. Data is Tesla's moat.

quiz.question: What is Tesla's current FSD classification?
